limits: Standalone operators using sealed donor Keccak and scalar-comparator sources; original nine DSOs are neither modified nor loaded.
Sampling uses the same lane-zero parser in both backends; this isolates Keccak state mapping, not ballot-compaction performance.
Kernel event times include output initialization, decoding and trace writes; no end-to-end production-module speedup is established.
ON/OFF changes this audit harness only. OFF uses eight squeeze blocks, rather than a production-module early-stop configuration.
Forced-rejection cases are synthetic refill/exhaustion fixtures, not normal FIPS vectors.
256 deterministic input rows are tiled across each batch; empty-input SHAKE has one unique row. Three processes reuse the same corpus.
All requests/bytes and counters are checked before and after each timed variant; individual intermediate timed outputs are not separately checked.
Shared stage lock and pre/post idle GPU samples are used; continuous exclusive GPU use is not claimed.
CPU-only self-tests do not establish CUDA compilation or device correctness; those must pass on the server before acceptance.
